Package de.hof.dms.domain

Class DocumentRecord

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.domain.DocumentRecord
public class DocumentRecord extends Object
Persistent entity for an uploaded document, stored in the MongoDB documents collection. The binary file itself lives in GridFS (referenced by gridFsFileId); this record holds the metadata, ownership/permission data (FolderAcl) and processing state.

Several string fields carry status/lifecycle values: ocrStatus tracks the OCR/text-extraction job (e.g. pending, running, done, failed), extractionMethod records how text was obtained (e.g. born-digital extraction vs. OCR), ocrError/retryCount capture failure details and retry attempts, indexingStatus tracks full-text index state, and documentStatus reflects the overall document lifecycle. eapNumber is the unique business identifier assigned to the document.
